name: La Ciau del Tornavento
dinnerNote: La Sorpresa della Cucina, 6 surprise courses (white truffle and 30-year menus also offered)

menus.name: La Sorpresa della Cucina tasting menu
menus.note: Six surprise courses chosen by the chef, for the whole table; lunch or dinner

bookingOpens: By phone or through the request form on the restaurant's website. A request is only a request: the restaurant checks availability and confirms; with no answer within 48 hours, call. No replies on Wednesdays and Thursdays, when it is closed.
dressCode: No dress code, but men are asked not to wear shorts or flip-flops.
children: Children are welcome, with a children's menu of smaller dishes and their own tableware, colouring and toys; parents are asked to keep the other guests' peace in mind.

stay.name: Locanda del Tornavento
stay.note: Four rooms in the old post office in Treiso’s village centre.
